added_lines: reflection you shall love the lord, your god, with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind. this is the greatest and the first commandment. the second is like it: you shall love your neighbor as yourself. by observing the second commandment you are actually showing that you love god with all your heart, soul and mind. the two commandments cannot be separated. every month when i visit houses, i witness the incredible care which sons and daughters and grandchildren give their parents. frequently, this care is given by neighbours and relatives as well. invariably at fu- nerals, it is humbling to again witness this compassion from family membe rs, friends and neighbours. annually when i witness the second and sixth classes making their first communion and confirmation, the children show that they understand showing love to the family and grandparents in a unique way at the sign of peace and at the end of mass. parishioners incidentally tell you about how generous and compassion - ate other people are, by visiting people in hospital, working with the vincent de paul society and visiting people in prison. yes all of these expressions of keeping t hese commandments happen in this family of parishes. so today let us thank god, that so many people observe loving god, with all their hearts, souls, and mind and loving their neighbours. blessing of the graves sunday 1st november kilquane - kindly remember in your prayers at this time nuala lee(rip), brooklodge, glanmire, formerly of annmount, glounthaune who died in the week gone by. we extend our sympathies and condolences to her relatives, extended family, friends and neighbours. may she rest in the peace of the lord. remembering our beloved dead throughout the month of november, we pray for and remember our departed loved ones especially during the novena of masses for the dead (holy souls novena) from monday 2nd to tuesday 10th november. envelopes and lists for the names of your beloved dead are available in the three churches of the parish and in the parish office. the names will be placed in a basket on the altar to be remembered during november, uniting our prayers for the faithful departed with christ’s sacrifice at every mass. when writing the names of those who have died, please don’t forget to include those who have no one to remember them. the blessing of graves sunday 1st november kilquane cemetery, knockraha: 10.00am (after the 9.00am mass). dunbullogue cemetery: 12.30pm. rathcooney cemetery: 3.00pm. sunday 8th november st. joseph’s cemetery, little island: 12.30pm. caherlag graveyard: 2.00pm. templeuisce cemetery: 2.00pm. ard na gaoithe cemetery: 2.30pm. ballinaltig cemetery: 3.30pm. sunday 15th november ballylucra cemetery: 1.00pm.
